title: Exact Security of Higher-Round Cascaded LRW1
summary: The three-round cascaded LRW1 instance has tight birthday-bound security, while the exact security of the general higher-round family remains unknown.

formal_statement.body: For the $r$-round cascaded $\mathrm{LRW1}$ construction with $r \ge 3$, determine the exact security as a function of $r$. The three-round instance is resolved, but the exact security of the general higher-round family remains open.

scope.domain: Exact-security analysis of cascaded LRW1 tweakable block-cipher constructions.
parameters: r: number of cascaded LRW1 rounds, with r at least 3
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the exact security of the general higher-round cascaded LRW1 family as a function of r.

citations.label: Tight Security of TNT and Beyond: Attacks, Proofs and Possibilities for the Cascaded LRW Paradigm

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents the exact security of r-LRW1 as a natural open problem. The paper resolves the three-round case but reports no tightness result for higher rounds.
citation_labels: Ashwin Jha et al., Tight Security of TNT and Beyond: Attacks, Proofs and Possibilities for the Cascaded LRW Paradigm
